(() => {
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.style.width = '37px';
  document.body.append(target);
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = '.'+'x'.repeat(160)+'{'+Array.from({length:20},(_,i)=>'.child'+i+'{width:1px}').join('')+'}';
  document.head.append(style);
  let limited = false;
  try { getComputedStyle(target).width; } catch(error) { limited = error.message.endsWith('resource limit: stylesheet nesting output bytes'); }
  style.remove();
  const recovered = getComputedStyle(target).width === '37px';
  target.remove();
  return {limited,recovered};
})()
